subject: general
question: The _______ is an unbiased estimator of the population mean.
solution:
The correct answer is** sample mean.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sample Mean:**

 
 
• The sample mean is the arithmetic average of all sample observations and serves as an unbiased estimator of the population mean.
 
• In financial enterprises, it is often used to estimate the average return on investments, average costs, or other financial metrics.
 
• An unbiased estimator means that the expected value of the sample mean equals the true population mean, making it a reliable measure for decision-making.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sample Mode:**

 
 
• The sample mode is the most frequently occurring value in a data set. It is not an unbiased estimator of the population mean because it does not consider all data points.
 
• In a financial context, the mode might be used to identify the most common transaction amount but is not useful for estimating average values.
 
 
 
• **Sample Variance:**
 
 
• The sample variance measures the dispersion of data points around the sample mean. It is not an estimator of the population mean but rather of the population variance.
 
• In finance, sample variance is used to assess the volatility of asset returns, not to estimate average returns.
 
 
 
• **Sample Median:**
 
 
• The sample median is the middle value when the data is ordered. While it is a measure of central tendency, it is not an unbiased estimator of the population mean.
 
• In financial enterprises, the median might be used to identify the central tendency in skewed distributions but not for estimating the mean.
